scope: SLC43 tree with slc43a2-family predictions from three further Beloniformes. A gene tree places sequences; it does not prove orthology.
question: With four Beloniform species represented, does flying-fish slc43locus02 resolve as the a paralog? Its support was 36.2/65 then 66.7/78 as the input improved.
note: The residue evidence already puts the flying-fish F326L signal in slc43locus02 and F in the halfbeak and needlefish loci, so tree and residue evidence can be compared for consistency.
